title: What the Menzerath–Altmann exponent measures: clauses, morphemes and syllables in Uzbek — supplementary package
description: Supplementary package for a preregistered study of the Menzerath–Altmann law in Uzbek at three levels: sentence–clause–word, word–morpheme–grapheme and word–syllable–grapheme. It contains the preregistration and its amendment, the frozen analysis script and the results of its single run, post hoc analyses, figures, and token- and clause-level count data (no text) from two Uzbek corpora and the UD Uzbek treebanks. The main fit table can be recomputed from the released data with the included script.
